_comment: ImageNet val demo set for inverse problem experiments. class_idx is the standard ImageNet 0-999 index (matches torchvision ImageNet ordering / synset mapping line number - 1). Curated for top-conference paper figures: no watermarks, no text overlays, no human faces; clean composition, recognizable subjects, texture-rich for SR/deblur showcases.
_source: /data/Zach_dataset/imageNet256/ILSVRC/Data/CLS-LOC/val (original ILSVRC2012, NOT pre-resized to 256 — apply center crop + resize before use)
